messages:
sam: starting rollout for featurematrix v2 -> shifting 50% traffic to edge pool (us-west-2) at 17:03 UTC. i'll monitor metrics, tagging @oncall.
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INCIDENT TRIGGERED - service: edge-proxy-usw2 - high 5xx rate (threshold: 0.5%) - Severity: P1 - incident id: PD-34821
incident-bot: autopage: page fired -> routed to maya (eng-oncall) and oliver (sre). runbook: `edge/5xx-surge`.
maya (eng-oncall): acked. i'm on it, jumping into logs and the canary dashboard. sam can you confirm traffic fraction and rollout id?
sam: rollout id r-2026-03-15-featurematrix, fraction=0.5. pushing a tiny config change earlier but nothing else. nothing in audit that should touch WAF.
oliver (sre): looking at logs - see a surge of `HTTP 503` + `upstream_reset` from edge sidecar starting 17:05. p95 latency spiked from 120ms -> 900ms. error rate ~3.8% on canary nodes.
kirti (support): seeing an uptick in support tickets saying "model responses failing" and a couple of 502s in repros.
julia (prodeng): any correlation with model bundle or quantization change? featurematrix is just traffic routing to new routing key.
sam: no model changes. just traffic split. unsure why sidecars are returning resets.
oliver (sre): grabbing sample logs:
```
[17:05:12] edge-sidecar svc=edge-proxy instance=us-west-2-c-12 upstream=embed-2 -> error: upstream_reset (connection refused) code=503
[17:05:15] proxy-conn thrift timeout after 1.2s
```
oliver (sre): looks like connection pool exhaustion to embedding fleet behind the proxy. canary suddenly heavier due to routing heuristic for featurematrix.
maya (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (traffic -> 0%) 2) divert canary traffic to fallback pool (legacy routing) 3) open pagerbridge if customers affected. sam can you pause now?
sam: pausing rollout now -> `r-2026-03-15-featurematrix` traffic fraction -> 0% (cmd: `ci-ctl rollout pause r-2026-03-15-featurematrix`). cicd-bot: rollout r-2026-03-15-featurematrix paused by sam at 17:09 UTC.
cicd-bot: rollback available -> traffic reverted to legacy routing for canary id r-2026-03-15-featurematrix.
oliver (sre): starting traffic divert to fallback routing for canary nodes. applying traffic rule: `edge.route.weight(featurematrix)=0 -> legacy=100`.
incident-bot: mitigation step recorded: traffic shifted back to legacy pool. observed error rate dropping - checking metrics.
maya (eng-oncall): metrics update at 17:12 - 5xx rate dropping from 3.8% -> 0.6% on canary. p95 latency back to ~140ms. looks like divert helped.
kirti (support): notified tier2 support and posted a short note to the customer-status channel: "We briefly observed elevated 5xx errors for a small portion of traffic due to a rollout. Traffic was rolled back and error rates are normalizing. We will follow up." customers with active sessions: ~12 requests failed within window.
julia (prodeng): request count on affected canary slice was ~2.1k req/min, not huge, but pool sizing mismatch with new routing pattern explains exhaustion.
sam: quick postmortem note: routing heuristic for featurematrix caused hot-sharding of embeddings. will revert the heuristic and add canary warmup.
maya (eng-oncall): recommend followups: - ramp policies: smaller increments - prereq warmup for connection pools - alert threshold tweak to detect pool exhaustion earlier
oliver (sre): created bug ENG-PLT-789 to track sidecar connection pool backpressure handling and a task to add a canary pre-warm. assigning to prodeng.
maya (eng-oncall): closing page in PD after ack gap check. paging summary: PD-34821 -> acknowleged 17:07, mitigated 17:10, resolved/closed 17:14.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-34821 status changed to RESOLVED by maya at 17:14 UTC.
sam: thanks everyone — i'll follow up with a short changelog and the rollback diff. tagging julia and oliver for the postmortem.
kirti (support): i'll draft the customer-facing blurb and send to comms for review.
maya (eng-oncall): adding final note: no large customer-impact observed, a handful of errors, all services healthy after rollback. we'll do a controlled re-rollout after fixes. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Autopage fired during a 50% traffic shift for featurematrix; oncall acked, rollout paused, traffic diverted to legacy routing, error rate recovered, followups created
